fields.name: task
fields.note: The coordination task, question, or trigger. Append '[COMPOSITION DREAMING — TENSION AUDIT]' to activate Stage 4 (valence audit, structural composition proposals, cascade RSI writes).

fields.name: workspace_id
fields.note: Target workspace ID. If omitted, resolved from the execution context.

fields.name: focus_agent
fields.note: If provided, Stage 0 solicits a plan from only this agent rather than the whole roster. Used to target a single member's intentions rather than running a full team pre-flight.
